description: The Frobenius Gram G_ij = tr_M(b_i b_j) of the H_3 normal-form basis has signature (5,1) — Lorentzian, one negative direction, with a +/-0.855067 hyperbolic pair. The T4/T5 channel S = A*kappa*(ln^2 q0 - theta^2) has the same signature, and the corpus describes boost/spin structure in two other places. Controls whether the signature is constant in q (structural) or an accident at q0, then tests three declared readings of the per-anchor offset decomposed in the Lorentzian frame against the A_omega-free constraint curve. A signature match is a structural fact, not a determination of theta. Nothing fitted; nothing wired.

signature_transition_q_c.RETRACTED: Earlier versions of this witness reported q_c ~ 1.03, a signature transition to (4,2) below the substrate point. It does not exist. The old `gram_at_h` control assigned h = q - 1/q for the new q but left the Markov weight z = 1/(q^1/2 + q^-1/2) at q0, so the matrix it diagonalised was not the Gram of any single q. Rebuilt consistently via gram_matrix_mp(q=...), lambda_min < -0.7 everywhere on [1, 2.5] and tends to -3/4 at q = 1; the signature is (5,1) throughout. What vanishes at q = 1 is lambda_2 ~ h/2 > 0, the classical-limit degeneracy.

data.verdict: THE FROBENIUS GRAM OF H_3 AT q0 IS LORENTZIAN — signature (4, 1), exactly one negative direction, with a +/-0.855067 hyperbolic pair. THE SIGNATURE IS STABLE ON THE WHOLE RANGE, NOT A SINGLE-POINT ACCIDENT: inertia (4,1,1) holds at every tested q from 1.02 to 2.5, an interval containing q0 = 1.1102, and the negative eigenvalue never approaches zero — it runs -0.855 at q0 down to exactly -3/4 at q = 1. CORRECTION to the previous version of this witness, which claimed the signature becomes (4,2) below a threshold q_c ~ 1.03: that threshold does not exist. It was an artifact of rebuilding the Gram with h at the new q while leaving the Markov weight z at q0, an inconsistent matrix. Rebuilt consistently the Lorentzian signature is stable for all q > 1; what vanishes at q = 1 is a POSITIVE eigenvalue, lambda_2 ~ h/2, the classical degeneracy where H_3(q) becomes the group algebra — not a loss of the timelike direction. The structural reading is strengthened, not weakened, by the fix. That matters because the T4/T5 channel S = A*kappa*(ln^2 q0 - theta^2) has exactly that signature, the T4 probe's own vocabulary is boost/spin-dominated, and CuspShapeBarParity independently puts q on a boost hyperbola — three places describing a Lorentzian structure the Gram supplies. NONE OF THE FOUR DECLARED READINGS SUPPLIES theta: all fail the A-free curve's necessary straddling condition. The signature match is therefore a STRUCTURAL observation and NOT a determination of theta_K — precisely the distinction this arc keeps having to enforce. A SECOND, INDEPENDENT STRUCTURAL FACT: the unique timelike (negative-norm) direction is EXACTLY the bar-odd combination (L- - L+)/sqrt(2) of L+ = s0s1 and L- = s1s0 — every other component vanishes to 1e-9. CuspShapeBarParity independently states that the meridian is the bar-odd (boost) cycle, so two unrelated corpus objects agree on which direction is the boost. That is corroboration, not a fit — nothing was tuned to produce it. THE SCALE FILTER, which is the arc-level lesson: the A-free curve forces both theta to be O(ln q0) ~ 0.1, so theta is a LOGARITHMIC quantity. Every reading tried across this whole SDP sweep except the last produced O(1)-O(5) numbers and was excluded BY SCALE ALONE, without needing the straddling test. Candidates should be filtered by scale BEFORE being measured. The one reading with the right scale, inverse_rapidity = artanh(timelike/spacelike) (the defined companion for a SPACELIKE offset, which both turn out to be), gives 0.18715 and 0.01561 against targets 0.05895 and 0.20324 — the right order of magnitude but with the anchors in the OPPOSITE order. Swapping them would be a FIT and is not permitted; decisively, the swap would not rescue it either (the smaller value misses its target by ~3.8x), so this is a genuine miss and NOT a signal suppressed by the anchor assignment. SCOPE (a): four readings of the Lorentzian decomposition, all declared before evaluation and all reported. Untried and not excluded: the offset's components in the WEDDERBURN block basis rather than the eigenframe, and a reading built from the +/-0.855067 hyperbolic plane alone. Nothing fitted; nothing wired.
